list_activity_logs.title: Get/Search activity logs
list_activity_logs.description: Search the shop's audit trail of subscription events: contract, billing, plan, shipping, swap and settings changes, each with source (portal, merchant, API, Shopify, system), status and actor.

entity_id.description: Only logs whose entity id equals this.

entity_type.description: Only logs whose entity type equals this.

event_source.description: Only logs whose event source equals this.

event_type.description: Only logs whose event type equals this.

status.description: Only logs whose status equals this.

activity_by.description: Only logs whose actor equals this.

created_from.description: Only logs created at or after this ISO 8601 instant.

created_to.description: Only logs created at or before this ISO 8601 instant.

output.description: Activity logs successfully retrieved. Returns paginated list of activity log entries.

associate_external_payment_profile.title: Associate external payment gateway customer with Shopify customer
associate_external_payment_profile.description: Link a customer's payment profile at Stripe, Braintree, PayPal or Authorize.Net to their Shopify customer so subscriptions can charge it -- used when migrating subscriptions in.

customer_id.description: Id of the customer to associate payment method with

email.description: Email of the customer to associate payment method with

customer_profile_id.description: Id of customer in external payment gateway, not required for Paypal

payment_profile_id.description: Card Id or payment profile Id in external payment gateway

output.description: Successfully associated external payment gateway customer with Shopify customer. Returns Shopify GraphQL raw response.

create_build_a_box.title: Create a new Build-A-Box subscription bundle
create_build_a_box.description: Create a Build-a-Box bundle that lets customers pick products for a recurring box: product source, min/max counts, discounts, layout and texts.

bundle.description: The bundle: shop (required), name, buildABoxType, productSelectionType, collectionData, minProductCount, maxProductCount, discount, sections...

update_build_a_box.title: Update an existing Build-A-Box subscription bundle
update_build_a_box.description: Update a Build-a-Box bundle's settings, product selection or pricing. Send the bundle with its id.

bundle.description: The bundle with id and shop and the fields to change.

get_build_a_box_by_handle.title: Retrieve Build-A-Box bundle details by handle for customer storefront
get_build_a_box_by_handle.description: Read a Build-a-Box bundle by its handle (url slug), as a storefront would.

output.description: Bundle and subscription details successfully retrieved

delete_build_a_box.title: Delete a Build-A-Box subscription bundle
delete_build_a_box.description: Delete a Build-a-Box bundle so no new customers can subscribe to it; existing subscriptions continue.

output.description: Build-A-Box bundle successfully deleted. No content returned.

get_build_a_box.title: Retrieve a Build-A-Box bundle by ID
get_build_a_box.description: Read a Build-a-Box bundle by id with all its product, pricing and delivery settings.

bulk_update_billing_interval.title: Bulk update subscription billing interval
bulk_update_billing_interval.description: Change the billing interval of many contracts (or all) at once.

output.description: Bulk billing interval update successfully queued and initiated.

bulk_update_delivery_method.title: Bulk update subscription delivery method
bulk_update_delivery_method.description: Change the delivery method of many contracts (or all) at once.

output.description: Bulk delivery method update successfully queued and initiated.

bulk_update_delivery_price.title: Bulk update subscription delivery price
bulk_update_delivery_price.description: Change the delivery price of many contracts (or all) at once.

output.description: Bulk delivery price update successfully queued and initiated.

bulk_hide_subscriptions.title: Hide subscriptions in bulk
bulk_hide_subscriptions.description: Hide many contracts (or all) from the customer portal without cancelling them.

output.description: Bulk hide operation successfully queued and initiated. Subscriptions will be hidden asynchronously.

bulk_replace_product.title: Replace products in subscriptions in bulk
bulk_replace_product.description: Replace old variants with new ones across many contracts (or all), e.g. for a discontinued product.

output.description: Bulk product replacement operation successfully queued and initiated. Subscriptions will be updated asynchronously.

get_cancellation_settings.title: Get cancellation management configuration
get_cancellation_settings.description: Read the cancellation flow settings: retention offers, cancellation reasons and feedback prompts, optionally in one language.

get_subscription_contract_raw_response.title: Retrieve raw Shopify GraphQL response for a subscription contract
get_subscription_contract_raw_response.description: Fetch the unprocessed Shopify GraphQL response for a subscription contract, for debugging a contract whose Appstle view looks wrong. get_subscription_contract returns the same data by path.

contract_id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription contract. Use the numeric ID without the 'gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/' prefix. For example, use '26833420451' instead of 'gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/26833420451'.

get_customer_portal_settings.title: Get customer portal settings
get_customer_portal_settings.description: Read the shop's customer portal settings: which actions subscribers may take (pause, skip, swap, cancel, change date or address) and portal text.

get_portal_token.title: Generate customer portal authentication token
get_portal_token.description: Generate a time-limited customer-portal authentication token for a customer, by id or email, for a custom portal front end.

list_retention_activities.title: Get customer retention activities
list_retention_activities.description: List retention activities -- each time a customer entered the cancel or pause flow and accepted or declined an offer -- filtered by contract, source, status, action, reason and date range.

contract_id.description: See Appstle's reference.

list_contract_delivery_options.title: Get delivery options for subscription contract
list_contract_delivery_options.description: List the delivery methods valid for a contract given its address and products -- the values update_contract_delivery_method accepts.

contract_id.description: Contract Id

create_shipping_profile.title: Create a new shipping/delivery profile
create_shipping_profile.description: Create a shipping profile for subscription products with countries, rates and delivery methods (original request format).

create_shipping_profile_v2.title: Create a new shipping/delivery profile (V2)
create_shipping_profile_v2.description: Create a shipping profile for subscription products using the V2 request format (per-location zones and methods).

create_shipping_profile_v3.title: Create a new shipping/delivery profile (V3)
create_shipping_profile_v3.description: Create a shipping profile using the V3 format, the most complete: locations, zones, and the selling plan groups it applies to.

get_portal_link.title: Generate customer portal access link by customer ID or email
get_portal_link.description: Generate a time-limited customer-portal link for a customer, looked up by id or email.

get_portal_link_by_customer_id.title: Generate customer portal link
get_portal_link_by_customer_id.description: Generate a time-limited customer-portal link for a Shopify customer id.

customer_id.description: Customer ID to generate portal link for. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

list_product_swaps.title: Get all product swaps for a shop
list_product_swaps.description: List product swap automations -- rules that replace products in orders at given billing cycles -- optionally filtered by rule name or source/destination variants.

create_product_swap.title: Create a new product swap automation
create_product_swap.description: Create a product swap automation. Deprecated by Appstle, but still documented.

swap.description: The swap rule: shop, name, sourceVariants, destinationVariants, forBillingCycle, checkForEveryRecurringOrder, carryDiscountForward...

update_product_swap.title: Update an existing product swap automation
update_product_swap.description: Update a product swap automation, sent with its id. Deprecated by Appstle, but still documented.

swap.description: The swap rule with id and shop and the fields to change.

preview_contract_product_swaps.title: Get product swap variant groups for a contract
preview_contract_product_swaps.description: Preview which products a contract will be swapped to over its next 10 billing cycles under the shop's swap rules.

contract_id.description: See Appstle's reference.

output.description: Product swap variant groups returned successfully - Returns swappable variants for the next 10 billing cycles.

delete_product_swap.title: Delete a product swap automation
delete_product_swap.description: Delete a product swap automation. Already-swapped orders are unaffected. Deprecated by Appstle.

output.description: Product swap successfully deleted - No content returned

get_product_swap.title: Get a specific product swap by ID
get_product_swap.description: Read one product swap automation: source and destination variants, trigger cycle, and discount and email settings.

list_quick_checkout_links.title: List quick checkout links
list_quick_checkout_links.description: List the shop's quick checkout links (pre-filled subscription checkout urls), optionally paged with limit and nextToken.

update_billing_attempt.title: Update subscription billing attempt
update_billing_attempt.description: Update a billing attempt record (billing date, order note and other attributes) by sending the full attempt object.

billing_attempt.description: The billing attempt, as returned by list_upcoming_orders, with its changes. Needs id, shop and retryingNeeded.

update_order_note.title: Update order note for a billing attempt
update_order_note.description: Set the note on one upcoming order (billing attempt); it is copied onto the Shopify order.

bill_order_now.title: Trigger immediate billing for an order
bill_order_now.description: Process a queued billing attempt immediately, charging the customer and creating the Shopify order now instead of on its date.

list_past_orders.title: Get past orders
list_past_orders.description: List processed billing attempts for a contract or customer: successful orders, failures and skips. Paged with page/size/sort.

contract_id.description: Billing Attempt ID

get_past_orders_report.title: Get past orders report with detailed filtering
get_past_orders_report.description: Report on past billing attempts filtered by status, date range, attempt count and contract status, optionally with the Shopify error behind each failure.

contract_id.description: Filter by contract Id

include_shopify_exception.description: Include Shopify Exception in case of Failure

reschedule_order.title: Reschedule a billing attempt to a new date
reschedule_order.description: Move one billing attempt to a new date, optionally shifting later orders too.

skip_order.title: Skip a specific order
skip_order.description: Skip one queued billing attempt so it is not charged or shipped on its date.

skip_upcoming_order.title: Skip the next upcoming order for a subscription
skip_upcoming_order.description: Skip a contract's next queued order without knowing its billing attempt id.

list_upcoming_orders.title: Get upcoming orders (top orders)
list_upcoming_orders.description: List the queued (not yet processed) billing attempts for a contract or a customer -- the next orders, with their ids for skip, reschedule and bill-now.

contract_id.description: Contract ID

unskip_order.title: Unskip a previously skipped order
unskip_order.description: Restore a skipped billing attempt to QUEUED so it processes on its date.

get_bundle_settings.title: Get subscription bundle settings (Build-a-Box configuration)
get_bundle_settings.description: Read the shop-wide Build-a-Box bundle settings.

update_bundles.title: Update subscription bundling configuration
update_bundles.description: Update the product selections of one or more bundles by handle.

generate_bundle_discount_code.title: Generate discount code for bundle
generate_bundle_discount_code.description: Generate a Shopify discount code for a bundle cart at checkout.

get_bundle.title: Get bundle details by handle
get_bundle.description: Read a subscription bundle by handle: configuration, products, pricing and plans.

add_contract_line_item_with_price.title: Add product with custom price to subscription
add_contract_line_item_with_price.description: Add a product variant to a contract at an exact price, bypassing selling-plan pricing. Recurring or one-time.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to add product to

variant_id.description: Shopify variant ID of the product to add

price.description: Custom price for the product (in store currency). This exact price will be charged regardless of the product's normal price, selling plans, or frequency. If the shop has 'applySubscriptionDiscount' enabled, an additional discount may be applied on top of this price.

is_one_time_product.description: When true, product will only be included in the next order; when false, in all future orders

output.description: Product successfully added to subscription with custom price

list_subscription_contracts.title: Retrieve subscription contracts
list_subscription_contracts.description: Search subscription contracts, filtered by created/updated/next-billing date ranges, contract id, customer name, order name, status, billing interval, plan type, product, variant, selling plan and order amount. Paged with page/size/sort. Start here to find a contract id.

from_created_date.description: Filter by subscriptions created on or after this date

to_created_date.description: Filter by subscriptions created on or before this date

from_updated_date.description: Filter by subscriptions updated on or after this date

to_updated_date.description: Filter by subscriptions updated on or before this date

from_next_date.description: Filter by subscriptions with next billing date on or after this date. Note: Both fromNextDate and toNextDate must be provided together

to_next_date.description: Filter by subscriptions with next billing date on or before this date. Note: Both fromNextDate and toNextDate must be provided together

subscription_contract_id.description: Filter by subscription contract ID (partial match supported, case-insensitive)

customer_name.description: Filter by customer name or email (partial match, case-insensitive). Searches both customer_name and customer_email fields

order_name.description: Filter by order number (searches current order_name and historical orders in subscription_billing_attempt table, partial match)

billing_policy_interval_count.description: Filter by delivery interval count (Note: This parameter name is misleading - it actually filters the delivery_policy_interval_count field)

billing_policy_interval.description: Filter by delivery interval type (Note: This parameter name is misleading - it actually filters the delivery_policy_interval field)

plan_type.description: Filter by plan type classification. 'prepaid' = billing interval count ≠ delivery interval count, 'non-prepaid' = billing interval count = delivery interval count

record_type.description: Filter by record type. 'imported' = has imported_id, 'nonImported' = no imported_id

product_id.description: Filter by product ID (searches within subscription line items JSON). Provide numeric ID only

variant_id.description: Filter by variant ID (searches within subscription line items JSON). Provide numeric ID only

selling_plan_id.description: Filter by selling plan ID (searches within subscription line items JSON). Provide numeric ID only

min_order_amount.description: Filter by minimum total order amount (calculated from sum of line items: quantity currentPrice)

max_order_amount.description: Filter by maximum total order amount (calculated from sum of line items: quantity currentPrice)

get_contract_analytics.title: Get subscription contract analytics and revenue metrics
get_contract_analytics.description: Get a contract's lifetime metrics: total revenue, number of successful orders, and a formatted revenue string.

contract_id.description: Contract ID

list_selling_plan_billing_intervals.title: Get available billing intervals for selling plan(s)
list_selling_plan_billing_intervals.description: List the billing frequencies a customer can switch to for one or more selling plans -- the valid values for update_contract_billing_interval.

output.description: Successfully retrieved billing intervals (may be empty array)

create_subscription_contract.title: Create a new subscription contract
create_subscription_contract.description: Create a subscription contract for an existing Shopify customer: line items, billing and delivery interval, next billing date, delivery address and price, min/max cycles and custom attributes. Charges the customer's payment method on the schedule unless createWithoutPaymentMethod is set.

allow_delivery_address_override.description: Allow customer to change delivery address in customer portal

allow_delivery_price_override.description: Allow delivery price to be overridden

create_without_payment_method.description: If true, creates subscription without payment method. Status will be set to PAUSED unless skipPaymentCreateUnpaidOrder is also true.

currency_code.description: Currency code for the subscription (ISO 4217). If not provided, uses store default currency

custom_attributes.description: Custom attributes to attach to the subscription contract

customer_id.description: Shopify customer ID (numeric ID without gid prefix)

delivery_interval_count.description: Number of intervals between deliveries. If not specified, uses billing interval count

delivery_interval_type.description: Delivery frequency interval type. If not specified, uses billing interval

delivery_price_amount.description: Fixed delivery price amount in store currency

lines.description: Product line items to include in the subscription

location_id.description: Shopify location ID used for local pickup. Required when methodType is PICK_UP

max_cycles.description: Maximum number of billing cycles. Null for unlimited

method_type.description: Delivery method. LOCAL requires deliveryPhone, PICK_UP requires locationId

min_cycles.description: Minimum number of billing cycles required before cancellation is allowed

next_billing_date.description: Date when the next billing/order will occur

payment_method_id.description: Customer payment method ID. If not provided, the default payment method will be used. Can be null if createWithoutPaymentMethod is true.

skip_payment_create_unpaid_order.description: If true, billing attempts on this contract will create unpaid orders instead of failing when no payment method is present. Requires createWithoutPaymentMethod=true. Contract will be created as ACTIVE (not PAUSED) so billing can proceed.

status.description: Initial status of the subscription contract

get_contract_current_cycle.title: Get current billing cycle number for a subscription contract
get_contract_current_cycle.description: Get how many successful billing cycles a contract has completed (1 after the initial order). Useful before changing min/max cycles or cycle-based pricing.

contract_id.description: See Appstle's reference.

output.description: Successfully retrieved current billing cycle number

list_subscription_customers.title: Retrieve customers with subscriptions
list_subscription_customers.description: List customers who have subscriptions, filtered by name, email, or having more than one active subscription. Paged with page/size/sort.

name.description: Filter customers by name (partial match supported)

email.description: Filter customers by exact email address

active_more_than_one_subscription.description: When true, returns only customers who have more than one active subscription

replace_contract_variants.title: Replace product variants in a subscription contract
replace_contract_variants.description: Swap product variants on a contract: replace old variants (or one line) with new ones, recurring or one-time, carrying discounts forward if asked. Supports Build-a-Box sub-variants.

bab_parent_variant_id.description: When set, this is treated as a fixed-price Build-a-Box child swap: the numeric variant ID of the parent bundle line whose child products will be replaced.

bab_replace_sub_variant_details.description: Old-to-new child variant mappings applied to the parent bundle line's child products when babParentVariantId is set.

bab_require_all_source_variants.description: When true and babParentVariantId is set, a bundle line is only updated when every oldVariantId from babReplaceSubVariantDetails is present in the box. Default is false (each old-to-new mapping applies independently).

carry_forward_discount.description: Determines how discounts are applied to new products when replacing variants. If not specified, uses the merchant's default setting.

contract_id.description: The ID of the subscription contract to modify

new_one_time_variants.description: Map of one-time product variant IDs to add with their quantities. These products will be charged only once with the next order and won't recur. Useful for add-ons, samples, or limited-time offers.

new_variants.description: Map of new variant IDs to their quantities. Key is the numeric Shopify variant ID, value is the desired quantity.

old_line_id.description: Specific subscription line ID to replace. Use this for targeted replacement of a single line item. When provided, oldVariants should be empty. Format: gid://shopify/SubscriptionLine/[ID]

old_one_time_variants.description: List of one-time product variant IDs to remove from the subscription. Only removes one-time products that haven't been fulfilled yet.

old_variants.description: List of variant IDs to remove from the subscription. These are numeric Shopify variant IDs. Either provide oldVariants OR oldLineId, not both.

shop.description: The Shop of the subscription contract to modify

stop_swap_emails.description: If true, suppresses email notifications about the product swap. Default is false (emails will be sent).

list_customer_payment_methods.title: Get customer payment methods from Shopify
list_customer_payment_methods.description: List a customer's stored payment methods from Shopify -- cards, wallets, PayPal -- with ids update_contract_payment_method accepts.

output.description: Successfully retrieved customer payment methods from Shopify

split_subscription_contract.title: Split or duplicate an existing subscription contract
split_subscription_contract.description: Move (split) or copy (duplicate) selected line items of a contract into a new contract, optionally billing the new one straight away.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID

line_ids.description: Line item ids (gid://shopify/SubscriptionLineItem/...) to move or copy into the new contract.

get_contract_fulfillment.title: Get subscription fulfillment details for latest order
get_contract_fulfillment.description: Get fulfillment details for a contract's most recent successful order: tracking numbers and urls, shipment status, estimated delivery and fulfilled line items.

contract_id.description: Contract ID

output.description: Successfully retrieved fulfillment details (may be null if no orders exist)

list_contract_one_time_products.title: Get all one-time products for a subscription contract
list_contract_one_time_products.description: List every one-time add-on product attached to a contract's billing attempts.

contract_id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription contract to retrieve one-time products for

remove_one_time_product.title: Remove one-time product from subscription order
remove_one_time_product.description: Remove a one-time add-on variant from one billing attempt of a contract. Idempotent.

contract_id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription contract

billing_attempt_id.description: The billing attempt ID that contains the product to remove

variant_id.description: The Shopify product variant ID to remove from the one-time purchases

output.description: Successfully removed the one-time product or product didn't exist. Returns all remaining one-time products for the contract.

add_contract_custom_discount.title: Add custom discount to subscription
add_contract_custom_discount.description: Create and apply a manual discount on a contract: a percentage or fixed amount, per item or per order, for a limited number of cycles or indefinitely.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to apply discount to. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

percentage.description: Discount percentage (1-100). Required when discountType is PERCENTAGE

discount_title.description: Custom title for the discount. If not provided, a default title will be generated

recurring_cycle_limit.description: Number of billing cycles the discount applies to. Leave null for unlimited duration

applies_on_each_item.description: Application method: true = apply to each line item individually, false = apply to order subtotal

amount.description: Fixed discount amount in store currency. Required when discountType is FIXED or PRICE

add_contract_line_item.title: Add product to subscription
add_contract_line_item.description: Add a product variant to a contract, either recurring or as a one-time item on the next order only, at the plan's price.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to add product to. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

quantity.description: Quantity of product to add. Must be a positive integer

variant_id.description: Shopify variant ID of the product to add. Can be provided as numeric ID or with gid:// prefix

is_one_time_product.description: When true, product will only be included in the next order and automatically removed after fulfillment. When false, product will be included in all future orders until manually removed or subscription ends. One-time products are useful for samples, gifts, or limited-time additions

add_contract_line_items.title: Add multiple products to subscription
add_contract_line_items.description: Add several product variants to a contract at once.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to add products to. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

variant_quantities.description: Map of numeric variant id (no gid:// prefix) to quantity; null or 0 means 1, e.g. {"42549172011164": 2}.

apply_contract_discount_code.title: Apply discount code to subscription
apply_contract_discount_code.description: Apply an existing Shopify discount code to a contract's future orders.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to apply discount to. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

discount_code.description: Valid Shopify discount code to apply. Case-sensitive. Must be an active discount code in your Shopify store.

bulk_replace_line_item_attributes.title: Replace all line item attributes in bulk across subscription contracts
bulk_replace_line_item_attributes.description: Replace every line item attribute across many contracts (or all of them) with the given list. Attributes not in the list are removed.

contract_ids.description: Optional comma-separated list of subscription contract IDs to update. Example: 32665403611,3266540311,326654036123. Ignored if allSubscriptions=true.

all_subscriptions.description: If true, updates all active subscriptions of the shop. If false (default), updates only the provided contractId or contractIds.

attributes.description: Attributes as [{key, value}] to set on every line item.

send_portal_magic_link_email.title: Send magic link email to customer for portal access
send_portal_magic_link_email.description: Email a customer a magic link to their subscription portal, using the shop's email template. Although a GET, it sends a real email.

remove_contract_discount.title: Remove discount from subscription
remove_contract_discount.description: Remove a discount from a contract by its discount id; future orders are priced without it.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to remove discount from

discount_id.description: ID of the discount to be removed. Must be the full GraphQL ID including the gid:// prefix. You can find discount IDs by querying the subscription contract and looking at the discounts collection. Format example: gid://shopify/SubscriptionManualDiscount/123456789

remove_contract_line_item.title: Remove product from subscription
remove_contract_line_item.description: Remove one line item from a contract, optionally dropping the discount tied to it.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to remove product from. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

line_id.description: Line item ID of the product to remove. Must be the full GraphQL ID including the gid:// prefix

remove_discount.description: Controls whether to remove discounts that apply only to this line item. When true (default), line-specific discounts are removed. When false, attempts to retain discounts where possible. Note: Discounts that apply to multiple lines are always retained regardless of this setting

remove_contract_line_items.title: Remove multiple products from subscription
remove_contract_line_items.description: Remove several line items from a contract; removed one by one, so some can succeed when others fail.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to remove products from

remove_discount.description: When true, removes discounts that apply only to each removed line item. When false, attempts to retain all discounts. Discounts that apply to multiple lines are always retained regardless of this setting.

output.description: Products successfully removed from subscription (full or partial success)

update_contract_next_billing_date.title: Update next billing date for a subscription contract
update_contract_next_billing_date.description: Move a contract's next billing (order) date, optionally shifting later queued orders by the same amount.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to update

reschedule_future_order.description: If true (or value not provided), next billing date will be changed and also schedule for future upcoming orders will be changed based on new updated billing date. If false, then only next billing date will be changed, but the schedule for future upcoming orders will not change.

next_billing_date.description: New billing date in ISO 8601 format with timezone. The date must be in the future and may be subject to merchant-configured restrictions.

output.description: Billing date successfully updated. The response contains the updated subscription contract from Shopify with the new nextBillingDate.

update_contract_billing_interval.title: Update billing interval for a subscription contract
update_contract_billing_interval.description: Change how often a contract bills (e.g. every 2 MONTH). Recalculates billing dates, pricing and selling plan, and may change the delivery interval with it.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to update. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

interval_count.description: Number of intervals between billings. For example, intervalCount=2 with interval=WEEK means 'every 2 weeks'

interval.description: Type of interval for billing frequency

update_contract_delivery_interval.title: Update delivery interval for a subscription contract
update_contract_delivery_interval.description: Change how often a contract delivers, independently of how often it bills (for prepaid plans).

contract_id.description: Contract ID

update_contract_delivery_method.title: Update subscription delivery method
update_contract_delivery_method.description: Set a contract's delivery method (shipping, local delivery or pickup) by its title, code and presentment title, as listed by list_contract_delivery_options.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to update

delivery_method_title.description: Display name of the delivery method. This is what customers see. Ignored if delivery-method-id is provided.

delivery_method_code.description: Internal code for the delivery method. Often same as title. Used for system identification. Ignored if delivery-method-id is provided.

delivery_method_presentment_title.description: Localized version of the title for multi-language stores. Often same as title for single-language stores. Ignored if delivery-method-id is provided.

delivery_method_id.description: Optional Shopify DeliveryMethodDefinition ID. When provided, automatically fetches and applies the delivery method's title, code, presentment title, and price. Can be numeric ID or full GraphQL ID (gid://shopify/DeliveryMethodDefinition/123).

update_contract_delivery_price.title: Update delivery price for a subscription contract
update_contract_delivery_price.description: Override the delivery price charged on all future orders of a contract.

contract_id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription contract

delivery_price.description: New delivery price to be applied to the subscription contract. This is a fixed price that overrides any calculated shipping rates. Set to 0 for free delivery. Price must be in the shop's base currency.

output.description: Successfully updated delivery price and returned the updated subscription contract

update_contract_payment_method.title: Update subscription payment method
update_contract_payment_method.description: Switch a contract to another payment method the customer already has in Shopify (see list_customer_payment_methods).

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to update payment method for. Must be a valid contract ID that belongs to the authenticated shop.

payment_method_id.description: ID of the existing customer payment method to use. Must be a valid Shopify GraphQL payment method ID in the format 'gid://shopify/CustomerPaymentMethod/{id}'.

update_contract_frequency_by_compatible_.title: Update Subscription contract frequency by compatible selling-plan frequency
update_contract_frequency_by_compatible_.description: Strictly change a contract's frequency to one of its compatible options, by frequencyKey or by a sellingPlanId that belongs to a compatible option; rejects anything incompatible.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to update. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

selling_plan_id.description: A selling plan ID from a compatible frequency option. Provide the numeric ID without gid:// prefix.

update_contract_frequency_by_selling_pla.title: Update Subscription contract frequency by selling plan
update_contract_frequency_by_selling_pla.description: Change a contract's billing/delivery frequency by moving it onto another selling plan's frequency.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to update. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

selling_plan_id.description: The unique identifier of the new selling plan. Provide the numeric ID without gid:// prefix.

update_contract_line_item.title: Update multiple properties of a subscription line item
update_contract_line_item.description: Change a line item's quantity, price, variant and/or selling plan in one call; only the values given change.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID

quantity.description: New quantity for the line item. Leave unchanged if not updating quantity.

variant_id.description: New product variant ID in Shopify GID format (e.g., gid://shopify/ProductVariant/42549172011164). This updates the associated product. Leave this parameter blank if you are not switching products.

line_id.description: Line item ID to update. Must be the full GraphQL ID including gid:// prefix

price.description: New price for the line item in shop currency. Behavior depends on isPricePerUnit flag.

is_price_per_unit.description: Determines how price is interpreted for prepaid subscriptions: - true: Price is per unit (per delivery), will be multiplied by interval ratio - false: Price is total billing amount (for all deliveries in billing period) Example: Monthly billing, weekly delivery, price=$10 - isPricePerUnit=true:...

selling_plan_name.description: Name of the selling plan to apply. Takes precedence over current selling plan. Used to change delivery frequencies.

update_line_item_attributes.title: Update line item attributes for a subscription contract
update_line_item_attributes.description: Set the custom attributes (key/value properties) of one line item on a contract.

contract_id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription contract

line_id.description: The unique identifier of the line item to update

update_contract_line_item_price.title: Update product line item price
update_contract_line_item_price.description: Change the base price of one line item on a contract, keeping its existing discounts.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

base_price.description: New base price for the line item (unit price before multipliers)

line_id.description: Line item ID to update. Must be the full GraphQL ID including the gid:// prefix

update_contract_line_item_pricing_policy.title: Update line item pricing policy with cycle-based discounts
update_contract_line_item_pricing_policy.description: Set cycle-based pricing on a line item -- e.g. 10% off after 3 orders. At most two rules with distinct afterCycle values; an empty list clears them.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID

line_id.description: Line item ID to update. Must be full GraphQL ID format

base_price.description: Base price for the product (before any discounts). This is the starting price

update_contract_line_item_quantity.title: Update product line item quantity in subscription
update_contract_line_item_quantity.description: Change the quantity of one line item on a contract, re-checking Build-a-Box limits and recalculating discounts.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to update. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

quantity.description: New quantity for the line item. Must be a positive integer

line_id.description: Line item ID to update. Must be the full GraphQL ID including the gid:// prefix

output.description: Product line item quantity updated successfully

update_contract_line_item_selling_plan.title: Update selling plan for a subscription line item
update_contract_line_item_selling_plan.description: Move one line item onto a different selling plan, by id or name.

contract_id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription contract

line_id.description: The unique identifier of the line item in the subscription contract. Must be in full GraphQL ID format

selling_plan_id.description: The unique identifier of the new selling plan. Provide the numeric ID without gid:// prefix. Required if sellingPlanName is not provided. The plan must be: - Active in your Shopify store - Associated with the product variant - Part of an active selling plan group

selling_plan_name.description: The customer-facing name of the new selling plan. Required if sellingPlanId is not provided. This is the name shown to customers like 'Deliver every 2 weeks' or 'Monthly subscription'. Must match exactly as configured in Shopify

update_contract_max_cycles.title: Update maximum cycles for a subscription contract
update_contract_max_cycles.description: Set how many orders a contract runs for before it ends automatically (a fixed-length subscription).

contract_id.description: Contract ID

max_cycles.description: Maximum Cycles. The total number of orders after which the subscription will automatically terminate. Must be greater than or equal to the current cycle count and any configured minimum cycles.

update_contract_min_cycles.title: Update minimum cycles for a subscription contract
update_contract_min_cycles.description: Set how many orders a customer must take before they may cancel (a commitment period).

contract_id.description: Contract ID

min_cycles.description: Minimum Number of Orders. The minimum number of billing cycles a customer must complete before being allowed to cancel. Set to null to remove the minimum commitment. Common values: - 3: Three-month commitment - 6: Six-month commitment - 12: Annual commitment - null: No commitment

update_multiple_line_item_attributes.title: Update multiple line item attributes for a subscription contract
update_multiple_line_item_attributes.description: Set custom attributes on several line items of one contract in one call.

contract_id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription contract

attributes_by_line.description: Map of line item id (gid://shopify/SubscriptionLineItem/...) to a list of {key, value} attributes.

output.description: Multiple line item attributes updated successfully

update_contract_order_note.title: Update order note for subscription
update_contract_order_note.description: Set the note added to every future order a contract generates.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to update

order_note.description: Note text to be added to all future orders. Can include special instructions, preferences, or internal notes. Pass empty string to clear existing note. HTML tags are not rendered - stored as plain text.

send_payment_method_update_email.title: Send payment method update email to customer
send_payment_method_update_email.description: Have Shopify email the customer a secure link to update the payment method on a contract.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID for payment method update. Must be a valid contract ID that belongs to the authenticated shop.

update_contract_shipping_address.title: Update subscription delivery address and method
update_contract_shipping_address.description: Change a contract's delivery address, or switch it to local delivery or pickup at a location. Applies to future orders.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to update. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

update_contract_status.title: Update subscription contract status
update_contract_status.description: Set a contract's status to ACTIVE, PAUSED or CANCELLED. Pausing stops billing until reactivated; cancelling ends it.

contract_id.description: Subscription contract ID to update. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

status.description: New status for the subscription contract. Case-insensitive.

output.description: Status successfully updated - No content returned

get_subscription_contract.title: Get raw Shopify GraphQL contract response
get_subscription_contract.description: Read one subscription contract exactly as Shopify's GraphQL API returns it: lines, pricing policies, billing and delivery policies, customer, payment method, discounts and next billing date.

contract_id.description: Contract ID

output.description: Successfully retrieved raw Shopify contract data

cancel_subscription_contract.title: Cancel a subscription contract
cancel_subscription_contract.description: Cancel a subscription contract immediately, ending all future billing and deliveries, with optional feedback and an internal note.

id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription contract to cancel. Must be a valid contract ID that belongs to the authenticated shop.

cancellation_feedback.description: Optional feedback from the customer about why they are cancelling. This information is valuable for understanding cancellation reasons and improving retention.

cancellation_note.description: Optional internal note for recording additional cancellation context. This field is for internal use and not visible to customers. Can be used to track special circumstances, support ticket references, competitor information, or other relevant details about why the customer cancelled.

output.description: Subscription successfully cancelled. No content returned.

get_customer_portal_css.title: Get custom CSS for customer portal
get_customer_portal_css.description: Read the custom CSS applied to the shop's customer portal.

get_customer_subscription_details.title: Get detailed subscription information for a customer
get_customer_subscription_details.description: Read full details of every valid subscription a customer has: status, products, billing, delivery schedule and pricing.

output.description: Successfully retrieved customer subscription details. Returns array of subscription objects (may be empty).

sync_customer_from_shopify.title: Sync customer subscription details from Shopify
sync_customer_from_shopify.description: Re-sync a customer's subscription data from Shopify into Appstle, fixing drift between the two.

output.description: Customer subscription data successfully synchronized from Shopify. No response body returned. Check activity logs to verify sync completion and review changes made.

list_customer_contract_ids.title: Get valid subscription contract IDs for a customer
list_customer_contract_ids.description: List just the ids of a customer's valid (non-deleted) subscription contracts.

output.description: Successfully retrieved valid subscription contract IDs. Returns a set of contract IDs (may be empty if customer has no subscriptions).

get_subscription_customer.title: Get customer details with subscriptions
get_subscription_customer.description: Read a customer with their subscription contracts (paged by cursor).

id.description: Customer ID to retrieve. Provide the numeric ID without the gid:// prefix

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for subscription contracts. Use the cursor from previous response's pageInfo.endCursor to get the next page

list_subscription_groups.title: Get all subscription groups
list_subscription_groups.description: List all subscription groups (Shopify selling plan groups) with their plans and product counts.

create_subscription_group.title: Create a new subscription group (selling plan group)
create_subscription_group.description: Create a subscription group (selling plan group) with one or more plans and the products or variants it applies to; optionally all products or a collection.

is_add_all_product.description: Add all products from the store or collection to this subscription group. When true without collectionId: adds all active products in the store. When true with collectionId: adds all products from the specified collection. This operation runs asynchronously and may take time for large catalogs.

collection_id.description: Shopify collection ID to limit product addition when isAddAllProduct is true. Format: numeric ID without gid prefix (e.g., '123456789' not 'gid://shopify/Collection/123456789')

group.description: The group: groupName, subscriptionPlans (each with frequency, interval, discount...), productIds, variantIds, translations.

update_subscription_group.title: Update subscription group details and product assignments
update_subscription_group.description: Update a subscription group's name, plans and product assignments. Send the group with its id.

group.description: The group with id and the fields to change (groupName, subscriptionPlans, updateProducts, deleteProducts...).

list_all_selling_plans.title: Get all selling plans across all subscription groups
list_all_selling_plans.description: List every selling plan across all subscription groups in one flat list.

remove_products_from_all_subscription_gr.title: Remove products or variants from ALL subscription groups
remove_products_from_all_subscription_gr.description: Remove products and/or variants from every subscription group in the shop at once.

product_ids.description: Comma-separated list of product IDs to remove from all groups. Use numeric IDs without gid:// prefix.

variant_ids.description: Comma-separated list of variant IDs to remove from all groups. Use numeric IDs without gid:// prefix.

output.description: Products/variants successfully removed from all subscription groups

start_add_products_to_subscription_group.title: Add products or variants to an existing subscription group (async)
start_add_products_to_subscription_group.description: Add a large batch of products/variants to a subscription group asynchronously; returns 202 at once. Poll get_add_products_job_status. One job per shop at a time.

output.description: Job accepted and started in the background

get_add_products_job_status.title: Check status of an async add-products job
get_add_products_job_status.description: Poll the shop's async add-products job, checking subscriptionGroupId matches the group you started it for.

get_subscription_group.title: Get subscription group by ID
get_subscription_group.description: Read one subscription group (selling plan group): its plans, frequencies, discounts and products.

add_products_to_subscription_group.title: Add products or variants to an existing subscription group
add_products_to_subscription_group.description: Add products and/or variants (comma-separated ids) to a subscription group.

product_ids.description: Comma-separated list of Shopify product IDs to add. Adding a product makes all its variants eligible for subscription. Use numeric IDs only (e.g., '987654321,987654322,987654323')

variant_ids.description: Comma-separated list of Shopify variant IDs to add. Use this to enable subscription for specific variants only. Use numeric IDs only (e.g., '123456789,123456790,123456791')

x_return_short_response.description: Header to indicate if response should return only added products ID information. Set to 'true' for minimal response, any other value or omitted for full response.

output.description: Products/variants successfully added to subscription group

bulk_add_products_to_subscription_group.title: Bulk add products or variants to an existing subscription group
bulk_add_products_to_subscription_group.description: Add many products and/or variants to a subscription group, sent in the body to avoid url limits.

remove_products_from_subscription_group.title: Remove products or variants from a subscription group
remove_products_from_subscription_group.description: Remove products, variants, a collection's products, or everything from one subscription group.

product_ids.description: Comma-separated list of product IDs to remove. Use numeric IDs without gid:// prefix.

variant_ids.description: Comma-separated list of variant IDs to remove. Use numeric IDs without gid:// prefix.

collection_id.description: Shopify collection ID. When provided, removes all products from this collection (up to 5000 products). This is in addition to any explicitly specified productIds/variantIds.

delete_all_products_and_variants.description: Set to true to delete all products and their variants. Defaults to false.

output.description: Products/variants successfully removed from subscription group

regenerate_widget_scripts.title: Regenerate subscription widget scripts
regenerate_widget_scripts.description: Rebuild and redeploy the storefront subscription widget scripts, after a theme or settings change that is not showing.

output.description: Script regeneration initiated successfully. Returns true to confirm the process has started. Scripts will be regenerated asynchronously in the background and deployed to CDN within 1-2 minutes.

list_next_order_one_time_products.title: Get one-time products for next upcoming order
list_next_order_one_time_products.description: List the one-time add-ons on a contract's next queued order.

contract_id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription contract to retrieve upcoming one-time products for

output.description: Successfully retrieved one-time products for the next order

update_contract_custom_attributes.title: Update custom attributes on a subscription contract
update_contract_custom_attributes.description: Add or replace custom key/value attributes on a contract, which carry onto its orders. With overwrite_existing_attributes the given list replaces all existing ones.

custom_attributes_list.description: List of custom attributes to set on the subscription contract. Each attribute is a key-value pair that will be stored with the subscription.

subscription_contract_id.description: The ID of the subscription contract to update
